items.title: Curtis Mitchell Interview, 1996-04-02
items.q: That was before I went on the road with Lee Allen.

ctx.x: So you played with Montrell at Texas Lounge. What year was this?
That was before I went on the road with Lee Allen. And then Silhouettes and Ruth Brown and Clyde McFadden, you know.
I'd say that was around, around in the 60s.
